response: Ward S (Bhandup, Powai, Kanjurmarg) has billed Rs 7489270 of its Rs 9500000 monsoon road budget, or 78.8 percent, across 123 jobs. Of these, 32.5 percent were reopened within 30 days and 50.4 percent met their deadline. Some of this may reflect conditions: the city saw 18 days of heavy or worse rain, and the ward has a low lying index of 0.55. Still, Rs 959710 was billed on DLP roads. DLP means the road is still under the original contractor's warranty, so repairs should cost the city nothing; these bills should be checked. 6 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and need review. The top contractor by spend is Sahyadri Infra Works (synthetic). Work orders WO25-00019 and WO25-00649 are examples worth examining. Ward officers can ask whether the road in WO25-00019 was under DLP, and if so, why the city paid.
